background: BNP Paribas Fortis is the largest bank in Belgium and the Belgian retail and commercial arm of BNP Paribas, funded by Belgian deposits and lending to households, companies and the public sector, with Turkish and Luxembourg subsidiaries.
synthesis: The bank is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all on a stable outlook after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, and the grades rest on the parent. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 13.5% is in the bottom quarter, while leverage of 7.1% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is the weak side, with LCR of 130% and NSFR of 109% both in the bottom quarter, well under the peer medians, though CET1 has risen 0.7 points and leverage 0.4 points since 30 Jun 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
